notes.title: Introducing: Honky
notes.content:
[h2]The [url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45548675-Canadian-Games-Devs/sale/canadiansgamessale"]Canadian Game Sale[/url] is LIVE NOW!![/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45483908/e8c7e014a909a646c2841831ff12cecd3f936da8.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Check out 100s of other Canadian-made games, alongside [b]Croak Crusader[/b]![/p][p]A huge thank you to [url="https://store.steampowered.com/search/?developer=Breaking%20Walls"]Breaking Walls[/url] for organizing, and including us in this event.[/p][p][/p][h2]HONKY IS HERE[/h2][p]Honky is basically meant to function as the Yoshi to Captain Croak's Mario.
And you wield a minigun whilst riding on his back. Let's see Yoshi doing anything half as cool as that!![/p][previewyoutube="Dj1GyANRD5M;full"][/previewyoutube][p]If you've never been to the Great White North, you may be unfamiliar with Harp Seals. Dogs have never really caught on up here as a standard pet. Their fur coats often aren't enough to handle the extreme weather! On average, Canadian households own 1.46 Harp Seals. They are loyal, obedient, and great at fetching the mail (although they often bring it back soggy). Plus they can live for over 30 years! What more could you want from Man's Best Buddy?[/p][p][/p][h2]FOLLOW ALONG[/h2][p]Thank you very much for your interest in the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/search/?sort_by=_ASC&supportedlang=english&franchise=Croak+Crusader"]Croak Crusader series[/url]![/p][p]Be sure to Wishlist [b]The Champion of Canada[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3152060/Croak_Crusader_the_Champion_of_Canada/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]And you can play [b]Spawn of the Spore Spectre[/b] NOW entirely for FREE!!
Please be sure to drop us a review, as that feedback will help with the development of the sequel[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2997920/Croak_Crusader_Spawn_of_the_Spore_Spectre/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
